item.title: Anaheim's OC Vibe unveils six new bar and lounge concepts for Katella Commons
item.description: Anaheim’s massive OC Vibe mixed-use development reached a new milestone Tuesday as officials unveiled plans for six distinct bar and lounge concepts. item.description: The LA28 Executive Committee Board announced Wednesday that Casey Wasserman will continue as chair of the Olympic organizing effort. item.title: Elderly sisters die in suspected arson fire at Hollywood home
item.description: Two elderly sisters died in a house fire that investigators believe was arson. The fire erupted just before 3 a.m on Feb. 4 at a home on Vista Del Mar Ave. between Yucca St. and Carlos Ave. in Hollywood. According to the Los Angeles Fire Department, one victim was pronounced dead at the scene and another was taken to the hospital where she later died.
